question: Should OpenClaw accept this signed marketplace refresh trust-state behavior on the current stack, or require more proof or design changes before merge?
rationale: The code path is security-sensitive and upgrade-sensitive, and the protected maintainer label means automation should not make the trust-model or proof-overrides decision.

options.title: Require proof plus security signoff
options.body: Keep the PR in maintainer review until exact-head real behavior proof is added and a maintainer/security owner accepts the fail-closed and SQLite trust-state behavior.

options.title: Accept with maintainer override
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally accept the current test/CI proof and trust-model risk, but that should be an explicit override rather than an automated pass.

options.title: Pause for stack ordering
options.body: Wait to merge this until the CLI visibility or default ClawHub root follow-up stack is ready if maintainers want one coordinated trust rollout.

recommendation.title: Require proof plus security signoff
recommendation.body: Keep the PR in maintainer review until exact-head real behavior proof is added and a maintainer/security owner accepts the fail-closed and SQLite trust-state behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the live assignee and the reviewer who already handled the trust-model findings and CI repair on this PR.
